newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady in dull trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were steady on Monday for the third successive session amid dull trade, with spinners short of cash. Dealers said they expected prices to fall in the next few sessions.
"Banks pursuing a tight lending policy have created a liquidity crunch," dealer Adil Naseem said. Unless spinners get fresh credit limits they were unlikely to buy and prices could fall, he added.
In the kerb market NIAB-78 was traded at 2,250 rupees ($55.94) per maund (37.32 kg) and K-68 at 2,400 rupees, dealers said.
